# ProfiPrompt

## Canonical links

- Repository: https://github.com/file-bricks/ProfiPrompt
- Issues: https://github.com/file-bricks/ProfiPrompt/issues
- License: MIT

## Summary

ProfiPrompt is a local-first PySide6 desktop app for managing AI prompts, prompt versions, boards, clipboard copy modes, and TXT/PDF/JSON exports. The app stores user data locally as JSON and does not require cloud services or telemetry.

## Main interfaces

- Desktop app: `python src/profiprompt.py`
- Windows launcher: `START.bat`
- Library export: `profiprompt-library-v1.json`
- Web/PWA companion: `web_companion/`
- Platform smoke: `python src/platform_smoke.py --output-dir build/platform-smoke`

## Data and privacy

- Prompt and board data are local JSON files.
- Default user data lives under the local user profile in `.prompt_manager`.
- The Web/PWA companion is read-only and imports `profiprompt-library-v1.json` directly in the browser.
- No telemetry, cloud sync, analytics, or external API access is part of the app.

## Validation

- Python tests: `python -m pytest -q`
- Web/PWA tests: `node --test web_companion/tests/*.test.mjs`
- Compile smoke: `python -m py_compile src/profiprompt.py src/platform_smoke.py src/pdf_exporter.py manage_translations.py translator.py`

## Scope boundaries

- ProfiPrompt is a prompt-library and prompt-workflow tool, not an AI model runtime.
- The Web/PWA companion is for reading, searching, copying, and offline browsing exported prompt libraries; the desktop app remains the writer/editor.
- Future sync or cloud features should be explicit opt-in features and must preserve the local-first privacy model.
